            # Create our card arrangement strategy
            sorted_enc = sorted(enc_deck)

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[!] Error: {e}")
    finally:

                    if not data:
                        break
                    print(f"[*] Additional data: {data}")
            except:
                pass
